name: palate-beta
description: Palate beta. Use one Palate plugin at a time. Build source-aware Astro websites with live design choices, real Palate references and interactive motion. Continue existing sites and add Shopify buying journeys when the product needs them.

interface.shortDescription: Live website design grounded in real references
interface.longDescription: Use an existing website and its assets to explore working Astro designs, choose a direction and finish the site. Motion is part of the design. Shopify integration is available for commerce, while other websites retain their own requirements.
defaultPrompt: Use this website and its assets to show me three beautiful, interactive design options, then build the direction I choose.
